title: 第79章 嫁给我？你也配？
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 唐逸余光扫了我见犹怜的姜云娜一眼，得，又是个会演戏的。　　这演技，竟然比唐画还精湛三分，和颜霜玉不相上下。　　外表看上去挺清纯，开头特妈能茶死人！　　要是前身，说不定还会上当，但他尸山血海中杀出来的男人，还会踩这种坑？　　那天晚上那三个女人想睡他，他都没上当好吧！　　唐逸向后退了一步，手压着腰间的绣春刀，眯着眼道：“所以呢？姜小姐想干嘛？直接说，别废话。”　　“哭哭啼啼这一招，在我这里不管用！”　　见到唐逸脸上的嘲讽和冷漠，姜云娜才终于明白白天为什么唐逸会告诉她，现在的唐逸不一样了。　　以前的狗，现在似乎……变成狼了？！　　“逸哥哥……”姜云娜有些不死心。　　“没安好心就别惹我，我今天心情可不怎么好。”唐逸直接打断，转身就走，懒得陪他们演戏。　　只是唐画好不容易布好了局，连御史姜正都出动了，岂会让唐逸轻易离开？　　他从吊床上坐了起来，笑道：“小逸，娜娜和姜伯父今日是为了你而来，过来见下礼，可别失了礼，让人笑话。”　　唐逸压着绣春刀睨了唐画一眼，随即嘲讽一笑。　　老婊！　　他懒得和唐画扯淡，目光看向唐敬道：“唐侍郎，有话直说，我没时间和你们废话。”　　唐敬脸色沉了沉，很快脸上的阴沉又散去，他冲着姜正笑道：“姜御史别见怪，这小子自幼便被骄纵坏了，以至于都有些无法无天了。”　　看向唐逸，唐敬指尖轻轻转着棋子，道：“你还记得小时候你娘亲和姜夫人定的婚约吗？姜小姐今日带姜御史过来，就是为了婚约之事。”　　“你不是一直很喜欢娜娜吗？刚好，娜娜心头也有你，为父也觉得你们郎才女貌，天作之合，小时候未提交婚书，今日为父做主，帮你们把婚书续上。”　　“如此，以后你们就是真正的未婚夫妻了。”　　唐逸和姜云娜自幼有婚约，现在只不过是把婚约坐实。　　就算唐逸告诉陛下，陛下能说什么？他还能不讲理直接废掉唐逸和姜云娜的婚约？　　到时候陛下下旨赐婚，那唐家就只剩下唐画符合条件了。　　要是炎文帝知道唐敬此时的想法，肯定会喷他一脸：想什么没事呢？这好男儿朕早就给女儿留着了。　　至于沈园诗会，哼，沈园诗会是朕给女婿铺路好吗！　　唐逸听到唐敬的话，自然就明白了唐敬的目的，又看了一眼俏脸略带红晕的姜云娜，他嘴角渐渐泛起笑容。　　“你，想要嫁给我？”唐逸平静开口。　　“我和逸哥哥自幼青梅竹马，我是愿意嫁给逸哥哥的。”姜云娜羞涩点头。　　心头确实一阵冷笑。　　订婚而已，又不是结婚。　　等画哥哥和孔诗岚的事情妥当了，再将你一脚踹开。　　想娶我？呵，你一个不受宠的唐家废物，也配？　　她心头正不屑地想着，唐逸淡淡瞥了她一眼，淡漠开口：“但是，我不想娶你。”　　“想嫁给我，你，也配？”　　听到这话，唐家众人再度错愕看着唐逸，他竟然拒绝了？　　他不是很喜欢姜云娜的吗？　　姜云娜呆住，拒绝了？他竟然敢拒绝？　　一个给画哥提鞋都不配的废物，也敢拒绝她，羞辱她？　　“放肆！”　　姜正见到女儿受辱猛地站了起来，面带怒色：“唐侍郎，这就是你教育出来的好儿子？”　　唐敬脸色也是阴沉下来，站在来看向唐逸道：“婚姻大事，父母之命媒妁之言，岂能由你胡闹？”　　“唐逸，还不给娜娜道歉。”　　说这话时唐敬语气冰冷无比，唐画找姜云娜帮忙，这无疑是目前破局最好的办法。　　但是，唐逸竟然不答应。　　混账东西，和唐家荣耀比起来，个人得失算什么？　　娶孔诗岚，你配吗？孔家乃是京都屹立数百年的名门望族，唯有画儿才配得上。　　唐浩也找到了机会，指着唐逸怒斥：“唐逸，娜娜还看得上你，是你的荣幸，你竟然还敢拒绝，你别不识好歹。”　　林竹也想要趁机骂两句，但这种场合下，她不敢造次，只能冷冷地盯着唐逸，眼中的怨毒几乎都要溢出来了。　　因为唐逸，她现在都成了京都的大笑话，成了无数人眼中的恶妇。　　颜霜玉笑着站在唐敬的身侧，没有说话，有姜正在，她就没必要出手。　　姜正是朝中出了名的毒嘴御史，唐逸得罪他，他能在朝堂上将唐逸喷个半死。　　当然，前提是唐逸能有命活到那个时候。　　她让唐浩再度从地下钱庄借了一万两，已经将唐逸的悬赏令放到了暗榜上，想必很快就会有暗京楼的杀手，为了这一万两银子来取唐逸脑袋了！　　而暗京楼是江湖上最大的杀手组织，既然接了任务，只要唐逸不死，他们就会一直追杀下去。　　唐逸什么时候死，任务什么时候结束。　　“不识好歹？不识好歹的难道不一直是你们吗？”　　唐逸压着绣春刀，盯着唐敬的目光充满嘲讽：“唐侍郎为了你这庶出的大儿子，还真是无所不用其极啊！”　　“你以为给我说一门亲事，陛下就会赐婚给唐画了？”　　“真是可笑！你不过是陪着唐画，在作死的道路上越走越远罢了。”　　“够了！”一声冷喝打断唐逸。　　是姜云娜。　　唐画是她心中最完美的男人，英俊，儒雅，博学，多才，岂能是唐逸一个废物能侮辱的。　　她真是瞎了眼，以前竟然还有点可怜这个混账。　　“唐逸，不许你这样说画哥哥，画哥哥那么完美那么好，你算什么东西敢说他？”　　话刚出口，姜云娜便察觉到自己失态了。　　她眼一眨，脸上的愤怒迅速敛去，装得一副可怜兮兮。　　见到唐逸看来，她有些慌乱，道：“逸哥哥，你别生气，画哥哥三元及第，是唐家甚至是整个大炎的荣耀，你不能这么说他的。”　　荣耀？唐逸轻笑一声，道：“有没有一种可能……是耻辱？”　　伪装出来的才华横溢，舞弊出来的金榜题名，抄袭出来的殿试状元……　　这些真相揭开的时候，真不知道那时他们又会是怎样的心情。　　嗯，挺期待的！　　刚好，马上就是沈园诗会了，希望你们沈园诗会后，还能笑得出来！
content_en: Tang Yi glanced at Jiang Yunna, who I felt pity for, and realized that she was an actor.This acting skill is actually three points better than that of Tang Hua, and is on par with Yan Shuangyu.She looks quite innocent on the outside, but she can make people laugh at the beginning!If it were his predecessor, he might still be fooled, but the man he killed out of the mountain of corpses and sea of ​​blood would still step into such a trap?Those three women wanted to sleep with him that night, but he didn't fall for it, right?Tang Yi took a step back, pressed the embroidered spring knife on his waist, squinted and said, "So? What does Miss Jiang want to do? Just say it, don't talk nonsense." "The crying trick doesn't work here!" Seeing the ridicule and indifference on Tang Yi's face, Jiang Yunna finally understood why Tang Yi told her during the day that Tang Yi was different now.The former dog seems to have... turned into a wolf?!"Brother Yi..." Jiang Yunna was a little unwilling to give up."If you don't mean well, don't mess with me. I'm not in a good mood today." Tang Yi interrupted directly, turned around and left, too lazy to act with them.It's just that Tang Hua finally laid out the plan, and even the censor Jiang Zheng was dispatched. How could Tang Yi be allowed to leave so easily?He sat up from the hammock and said with a smile: "Xiaoyi, Nana and Uncle Jiang are here today for you. Come here to see me, but don't be rude and make people laugh." Tang Yi glanced at Tang Hua with his embroidered spring knife, and then smiled sarcastically.Old bitch!He was too lazy to talk nonsense with Tang Hua, and looked at Tang Jing and said, "Shilang Tang, tell me what you have to say. I don't have time to talk nonsense with you." Tang Jing's face darkened, and soon the gloom on his face dissipated. He smiled at Jiang Zheng and said, "Jiang Yushi, don't be surprised.This kid has been spoiled by arrogance since he was a child, and he has become a little lawless." Looking at Tang Yi, Tang Jing gently turned the chess piece with his fingertips and said, "You still remember the engagement between your mother and Mrs. Jiang when you were a child."Miss Jiang brought Jiang Yushi here today just for the engagement.""Haven't you always liked Nana? It just so happened that Nana also had a crush on you, and my father also thought that you were a perfect match when you were young.The marriage contract has not yet been submitted.Today I will help you renew the marriage contract." "In this way, you will be a real unmarried couple." Tang Yi and Jiang Yunna have been engaged since childhood, but now they are just confirming the engagement.Even if Tang Yi tells His Majesty, what can Your Majesty say?Can he still unreasonably cancel the engagement between Tang Yi and Jiang Yunna?When His Majesty decrees the marriage, only Tang Hua from the Tang family will meet the conditions.If Emperor Yanwen knew what Tang Jing was thinking at this time, he would definitely sneer at him: What are you thinking about?I have kept this good man for my daughter a long time ago.As for the Shen Yuan Poetry Club, hum, the Shen Yuan Poetry Club will pave the way for my son-in-law, okay?When Tang Yi heard Tang Jing's words, he naturally understood Tang Jing's purpose. He glanced at Jiang Yunna, whose pretty face was slightly blushing, and a smile gradually appeared at the corner of his mouth."You want to marry me?" Tang Yi said calmly."Brother Yi and I have been childhood sweethearts since childhood. I am willing to marry brother Yi." Jiang Yunna nodded shyly.There was indeed a sneer in my heart.It's just an engagement, not a marriage.Wait until the matter between Brother Hua and Kong Shilan is settled, then I will kick you away.Want to marry me?Hey, you, an unloved loser of the Tang family, are you worthy?Just as she was thinking with disdain, Tang Yi glanced at her and said indifferently: "But, I don't want to marry you." "You want to marry me, are you worthy?" Hearing this, everyone in the Tang family looked at Tang Yi in shock again. He actually refused?Doesn’t he like Jiang Yunna very much?Jiang Yunna was stunned and refused?How dare he refuse?How dare a loser who is not even worthy of carrying Hua Ge's shoes dare to reject her and humiliate her?"Insolent!" Jiang Zheng stood up suddenly when he saw his daughter being humiliated, with an angry look on his face: "Shilang Tang, is this the good son you raised?" Tang Jing's face also darkened, and he stood and looked at Tang Yida: "Marriage"Tang Yi, why don't you apologize to Nana?"When Tang Jing said this, his tone was extremely cold.Tang Hua asked Jiang Yunna for help. This was undoubtedly the best way to break the situation.However, Tang Yi didn't agree."You bastard, what are your personal gains and losses compared to the glory of the Tang family?"Are you worthy of marrying Kong Shilan?The Kong family is a famous family that has stood in Kyoto for hundreds of years, and only Hua'er is worthy of it.Tang Hao also found an opportunity, pointed at Tang Yi and angrily yelled: "Tang Yi, it's your honor that Nana still likes you. You dare to refuse, you are so ignorant." Lin Zhu also wanted to take the opportunity to curse, but in this situation, she did not dare to make a mistake, so she could only stare at Tang Yi coldly, the resentment in her eyes almost overflowing.Because of Tang Yi, she has now become a big joke in Kyoto and a bad woman in the eyes of countless people.Yan Shuangyu stood beside Tang Jing with a smile and said nothing. With Jiang here, there was no need for her to take action.Jiang was a notoriously venomous censor in the court. If Tang Yi offended him, he could spray Tang Yi half to death in the court hall.Of course, the premise is that Tang Yi can survive until that time.She asked Tang Hao to borrow another ten thousand taels from the underground bank, and she had already put Tang Yi's reward on the secret list. There would be assassins from the Anjing Tower coming to take Tang Yi's head for these ten thousand taels of silver!And Anjinglou is the largest killer organization in the world. Now that they have accepted the mission, they will continue to hunt him down as long as Tang Yi doesn't die.When will Tang Yi die and when will the mission end?"Don't know what is good? Aren't you always the ones who don't know what is good?" Tang Yi pressed the embroidered spring knife and stared at Tang Jing with mocking eyes: "Shilang Tang really does everything for your eldest son who is a concubine!""Do you think that if you propose a marriage to me, His Majesty will grant a marriage to Tang Hua?" "That's ridiculous! You are just accompanying Tang Hua as he goes further and further down the road of committing suicide." "That's enough!" A cold shout interrupted Tang Yi.It’s Jiang Yunna.Tang Hua was the most perfect man in her heart. He was handsome, elegant, knowledgeable and talented. How could Tang Yi be insulted by a loser?She is really blind. She actually felt a little pity for this bastard before."Tang Yi, you are not allowed to talk about Brother Hua like this. Brother Hua is so perfect and good, who do you think you dare to say anything about him?"
